description:
Change the saved keywords. Free, up to 100 per call.
action:
- save(keywords): Save keywords as the owner's own: Sightkick checks each on Google within a minute and puts it on its topic. A removed one comes back.
- move(keywords, to): Put keywords on a topic (its id, or "new" for one of their own). They stay where you put them.
- set_main(keyword): Make a keyword its topic's main keyword, while the page isn't written.
- remove(keywords): Take keywords off for good: Sightkick never adds them back.
- link(keywords, url?, articleId?, title?, clear?): Say which page targets these keywords: a URL of the site or a page's articleId. clear unlinks.
name: update_keywords
title: Change keywords
